summary: Let Procurement change a supplier's bank account
acceptanceCriteria: Procurement can submit a new bank account for an active supplier.
The new account must be approved by a Finance Approver before it becomes active.
The new account number is masked in the UI and API.
The change is recorded in the audit trail.

When a bank change is approved, payments still scheduled to the old account are put on hold for Finance review; a Finance Approver who did not request the change redirects or cancels each one. Held payments cannot be released.
